history.note: Launched 2026-05-08 with v4 spawn architecture: DisocclusionSpawner + DGP dictionary (kills the integer-pixel-aligned spawn basin), ConcatFusion (replaces global cross-attention), latent rank R=16 (passes the H002 SVD energy gate at 0.9918). Stopped on 2026-05-12 at step 74K when the GPU was reclaimed by another process; rather than resume for the remaining 26K steps we moved to v7 because the architecture has changed substantially (N-D Gaussian primitive with V_xt cross-correlation, parent-child loss-adaptive density, OSS-FX time-slice rendering) and the marginal v6.2 training would not validate any of that. v6.2's step-00074000.pt is preserved as the canonical baseline.
